---
title: "Education"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import yaml

with open('data/education.yaml', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

degrees = data.get('education') or []

for edu in degrees:
    status = " *(In Progress)*" if edu.get('status') == 'In Progress' else ""
    print(f"## {edu['degree']}{status}\n")
    if edu.get('concentration'):
        print(f"*{edu['concentration']}*\n")
    print(f"**{edu['institution']}** | {edu['location']}\n")
    print(f"{edu['period']}")
    if edu.get('graduation'):
        print(f"\n*Graduated: {edu['graduation']}*")
    print("\n---\n")
```
